collection.title: Mercedes-Benz SEC Class 1981 to 1992 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Mercedes-Benz SEC Class Saloon 1981 to 1992 will fit, this model requires a 20" wiper blade on both the drivers side on the passengers side. This model uses the Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
